_comment: Per-benchmark thresholds in nanoseconds (BenchmarkDotNet's Mean unit). The workflow fails when any benchmark's Mean exceeds its threshold. Generous defaults — tighten based on actual baseline runs (look at benchmarks/PaymentGateway.Api.Benchmarks/BenchmarkDotNet.Artifacts/results/*.md after the first run). Values are Mean in nanoseconds; 100_000 = 100μs, 500_000 = 500μs.
